name: CWC World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Billed by the fed's own pages as the title the Championship Tournament crowns at its pay-per-view, The Ascension (4 May 2008, the HP Pavilion, San Jose): 'the crowning of the first CWC World Champion'. No page names a holder, and no reign is filed.

name: Showtime Championship
epitaph: The fed's lower title, named for the network that carries its shows. The Big Bang Theory's chairman says the winner of the tournament's consolation match takes it, and the Whiplash of 13 March 2008 bills a first Showtime Title match for its triple-threat winner after The Ascension. No page names a holder, and no reign is filed.
